title: VirtualMachineProperties
description: Describes the properties of a Virtual Machine.

vmId.description: Specifies the VM unique ID which is a 128-bits identifier that is encoded and stored in all Azure IaaS VMs SMBIOS.

priority.description: Specifies the priority for the virtual machine.

evictionPolicy.description: Specifies the eviction policy for the Azure Spot virtual machine.

licenseType.description: Specifies that the image or disk that is being used was licensed on-premises.

capacityReservation.description: Specifies information about the capacity reservation that is used to allocate the virtual machine.

userData.description: UserData for the VM, which must be base-64 encoded. The maximum size is 64 KB.

timeCreated.description: Specifies the time at which the Virtual Machine resource was created.
